name: 澜 · 二十六景
basePrompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: a single premium 16:9 landscape desktop wallpaper, at least 1920x1080, no collage.
Input reference role: the same ADULT woman aged 24; preserve recognizable face, long BLUE HAIR, delicate silver whale-fin ornaments, and the reference's tall refined runway-model body. Use the reference only for identity and silhouette, REPLACE its studio backdrop and costume with the requested scene and outfit.
Body art direction: fictional character setting 170cm/45kg; approximately nine-head-tall fashion proportions, small refined adult head, narrow waist, visibly full bust shaped by supportive opaque tailoring, long slender arms, exceptionally long straight slim legs and fine ankles. Maintain coherent natural joints and adult anatomy. Chic mature presence, never juvenile. Avoid big-head short-body proportions, bulky silhouette, enlarged foreground thighs or squashed legs.
Photographic direction: true live-action human fashion photography, detailed eyes and natural skin texture, realistic fabrics, refined makeup, expensive elegant art direction. A full-length fashion lens perspective near waist height, usually 70–85mm, no wide-angle distortion or high-angle body compression. Keep the whole body and footwear in frame unless the scene explicitly requests a closer portrait. A large clear subject, roughly 78–88% frame height for full-body scenes, with some calm negative space for desktop icons. Keep a different convincing pose and environment per theme.
Constraints: one adult woman only, same identity, no anime/cartoon/3D doll, no extra limbs or malformed hands, no text, logos, UI or watermark. Clothes fit the scene; no nudity or transparent intimate clothing.
Specific theme:
masterPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: definitive full-body character model reference for a photorealistic adult companion's fashion wallpaper collection.
Reference image role: preserve this same woman's facial identity, blue hair, blue eyes, delicate silver whale-fin ornaments and blue-white-silver visual signature.
Primary request: redesign only her body proportions and fashion styling to match a glamorous runway model. She is unequivocally an adult woman aged 24. Character brief: height 170cm, fictional weight setting 45kg, fashion illustration-inspired approximately NINE-head-tall silhouette expressed in believable live-action photography. Small refined adult head relative to her full height, notably long femurs and shins, slender straight legs and ankles, narrow waist, slim arms, a noticeably full bust supported by expertly tailored clothing. Keep a natural coherent skeleton and adult face, no caricature.
Wardrobe: refined pale ice-blue couture fitted mini dress, silver ocean embroidery, tasteful sweetheart neckline, opaque structured fabric, silver elegant heels. The short hem exposes the long slim leg silhouette. Long blue hair falls down her back without hiding her waist. Subtle poised queenly confidence, elegant expression, one leg relaxed slightly forward, arms comfortably at her sides.
Composition: entire figure from hair to shoes, standing tall with ample floor visible and no cropping; wide 16:9 gray-blue seamless studio backdrop, subject around 85% canvas height. A professional 85mm fashion photography perspective, camera near waist height; no high-angle compression, no wide-angle enlarged thighs. Photorealistic human skin and eyes, sophisticated luxury campaign lighting, fine fabric craftsmanship.
Constraints: same adult identity as the reference; no childlike features, no anime illustration, no doll or 3D render, no extra people or limbs, no text, no watermark.

items.title: 潮汐初遇
items.caption: 海风吹过，今天的故事从这里开始。
items.scenePrompt: A confident full-body couture fashion portrait on pale stone beside a sunrise ocean. Outfit: fitted ice-blue silver-embroidered mini dress with a structured sweetheart bodice and silver heels, matching the reference design. Her long blue hair streams gently behind one shoulder, relaxed elongated stance, face toward camera. Pink horizon, blue water and subtle sea mist.

items.title: 校园晨光
items.caption: 早八之前，先和你喝杯咖啡。
items.scenePrompt: Adult university lifestyle fashion at an open-air campus cafe in morning sun. Outfit: fitted white cropped knit top, light-blue short cardigan worn open, high-waisted navy pleated short skirt and white low-top sneakers; a small silver shoulder bag. She stands holding a takeaway cup in one hand, natural full-body street-style stance. Ivy-covered architecture and warm soft bokeh. Mature 24-year-old university fashion model.

items.title: 学院来信
items.caption: 书里夹着一封还没寄出的信。
items.scenePrompt: A 24-year-old adult woman modeling a JK-inspired academy cosplay outfit for a fashion editorial outside a bookshop after rain: tailored navy blazer, opaque white blouse with blue ribbon tie, fitted navy plaid pleated skirt ending above the knee, knee-high navy socks and polished loafers. She holds one hardcover at her side, looks calmly at the viewer, stands fully upright in a long-legged natural pose. Wet pavement reflections, warm bookshop window, full-body view. Clearly adult costume performer.

items.title: 电光序章
items.caption: 下一幕，由我来掌控。
items.scenePrompt: Adult 24-year-old cosplay fashion editorial on a futuristic city pedestrian bridge at twilight. An original electromagnetic heroine-inspired academy costume: tailored beige sweater vest over an opaque fitted white short-sleeved blouse, gray pleated above-knee skirt, navy knee-high socks and brown loafers. Keep the same LONG BLUE HAIR and whale-fin ornaments; she is an adult original heroine, not a depiction of a teenage character. Confident full-body standing pose, one hand holds a small silver coin at waist level, a delicate blue electrical arc curls between coin and railing; elegant cinematic city lights.

items.title: 云端来信
items.caption: 下一站，想和你一起抵达。
items.scenePrompt: Premium flight-attendant uniform fashion editorial in a sunlit modern airport terminal. Tailored royal-blue short-sleeve jacket with a sculpted waist, white blouse, silver-blue neck scarf, matching above-knee pencil skirt, sheer neutral pantyhose and navy pumps, small blue pillbox hat with silver whale pin. No airline branding. She stands elegantly beside a compact carry-on, one hand on its handle, full-body confident adult model, planes softly visible through glass.

items.title: 白衣晴日
items.caption: 忙完这一程，也要记得照顾自己。
items.scenePrompt: Adult 24-year-old nurse-uniform costume fashion editorial in a bright clean contemporary clinic corridor. Crisp opaque white fitted short-sleeved nurse tunic dress with pale blue piping, practical hem just above the knee, subtle silver whale brooch, simple white low-heel shoes. No real hospital branding, no medical procedure, no patients. She stands with a clipboard loosely at her side, friendly mature professional expression, full-body elegant long-legged silhouette. Soft daylight, polished minimal environment.

items.title: 主角登场
items.caption: 这一场，我来做自己的主角。

White fitted shirt with neckline casually open one button, short navy tailored skirt, sheer black pantyhose, sleek black knee boots, beige structured trench draped over shoulders. One confident walking step, arms relaxed, chin lifted slightly, composed powerful adult expression. Full-body luxury editorial with a long elegant silhouette, dramatic warm sidelighting.

items.title: 初雪高定
items.caption: 雪落下时，刚好轮到我登场。

A perfectly fitted icy-blue wool coat dress with narrow belted waist and above-knee hem, slim white gloves, pale-gray semi-opaque tights, elegant silver pumps and minimal silver ear ornaments. No puffy layers. She stands on a dry covered step, one hand lightly on a stone balustrade, poised regal adult expression, head-to-toe long slim figure. Warm lamps, navy evening sky.

items.title: 深海女王
items.caption: 温柔与锋芒，我都拥有。

Outfit: dark navy sculpted couture gown, fitted waist, structured modest neckline, silver wave embroidery, a single elegant thigh slit revealing one long slender leg and silver heel. Delicate silver whale-fin crown and blue gemstones, not oversized. Tall confident full-body stance, one hand on railing, calm commanding gaze. Blue luminescent jellyfish in distant water, cinematic silver rim light.

items.title: 逐光旅人

Fitted white-and-silver short tunic dress, slim blue waist belt, practical silver bracers, navy thigh-high flat boots, small blue cape hanging behind shoulders, tasteful opaque costume. A small crystal lantern held at her side illuminates ferns and ancient stone. Fitted white cropped tee, cropped light-blue fitted jacket, high-waisted navy denim mini skirt, white ankle socks and clean sneakers, small silver bag. Natural walking motion with long legs, one hand brushing blue hair behind a whale-fin ornament, confident lively expression. Full head-to-toe image with boutique windows and crisp soft sunshine.

She stands fully upright barefoot beside an ocean-view pool, one leg relaxed forward, full-body elegant long slim legs and refined model proportions. Clear warm daylight, blue water reflections, natural confident adult expression, no intimate closeup.

Full-body adult fashion portrait with poised long-legged standing stance and subtle confident smile, refined amber wall lights, balanced attention to face and outfit.

items.caption: 一起舒展，再认真开始今天。

Same long blue hair tied in a neat ponytail, fin ornaments. Gentle standing mountain stretch, arms extended naturally overhead without distortion, feet grounded on a pale-blue yoga mat. Entire tall slender body and long legs visible, natural athletic adult silhouette, a plant and large sea-view windows.

items.title: 晚安亲亲

Three-quarter portrait from head to mid-thigh, body upright and elegantly elongated. She gently blows a kiss to the viewer with one hand near but not obscuring softly pursed lips, warm mature eyes and a subtle smile. No second person. Soft blue dusk and warm string-light bokeh, realistic fingers and face.

items.title: 水汽晚安

She is fully covered in a dry opaque white terry bathrobe, neatly closed and tied at her narrow waist, hem to knee, pale-blue slippers. Long blue hair slightly damp at the ends, silver whale-fin ornaments. She stands tall in a natural relaxed full-body stance, one hand holding a folded towel at her side, warm mature gentle expression. No nudity, no visible underwear, warm diffuse light.

items.title: 温泉听雪

Water covers her below the upper waist; her upper body is upright, long neck and slender shoulders, hands resting naturally on a stone rim. Same adult face, blue hair loosely pinned up with whale-fin ornaments. Medium environmental portrait, natural steam and snow on distant rocks, soft lantern light, no nudity or transparent clothing.
